summary: This chunk adds three new JSON files for a graded eval run (iteration-2, eval-1-cache-design-redteam, with_skill, run-1): grading.json, run-1/timing.json, and a duplicate top-level timing.json. grading.json records 9 expectations (all passed), execution metrics (11 tool calls, 8 steps, 1 error), timing (118s, 66749 tokens, noting the run was killed by a session limit and resumed), 7 factual/process claims about a cache-design adversarial review (mostly verified), user notes on uncertainties and workarounds, and eval_feedback suggesting two improvements to the expectation set. The two timing.json files are identical, giving token/duration totals for the resumed segment.
